title: 第2231章 论剑下第2230章 论剑上
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
第2231章论剑（下）
霍凌霄提出想和洛千凝比试一下，也只是一时兴起，但很快就意识到了自己的唐突。
对方的是剑阁老祖云璃月的挚友，即便霍凌霄是剑阁的当代阁主，也没资格随便向对方讨教。
然而令他没有想到的是洛千凝平易近人，对于霍凌霄提出的请求，非常痛快的就答应了。
霍云霄见此一阵狂喜，其他剑阁内的剑仙更是一个个翘首以盼！
这可是仙王之间的对决，而且两位还都是剑仙！
最重要的是，他们终于可以真正的领教一下，洛千凝的混沌剑意到底有多么强大了！
“多谢仙子成全，那我就不客气了！”
霍凌霄眼中精光暴涨，周身剑道气韵瞬间极致迸发！
嗡——
一声响彻群山的剑鸣骤然炸开！
他背后悬浮的本命仙剑骤然出鞘，青芒万丈，横贯云海，数万载沉淀的剑阁正统剑道全力催动，凌厉、厚重、破妄、镇狱四道极致剑意融为一体，化作滔滔剑海，席卷整座论剑台。
仙王中期的浩瀚威压铺天盖地而来，长空震颤，流云碎裂，地底万古剑痕尽数亮起璀璨灵光，整座剑阁的剑道气运皆被他引动，加持己身！
与此同时，这些剑意环绕其身，形成了一个强大的剑阵，这与云璃月所创的剑道完全契合！
这是霍凌霄的巅峰剑道！
毫无保留，纯粹印证本心，只为切磋悟道，不求胜负杀伐。
“斩天剑！”
霍凌霄低喝一声，剑光冲天而起，万千剑丝汇聚成阵归一，化作一柄横贯天地的青色巨剑，裹挟着镇压万古、斩尽虚妄的磅礴大势，朝着洛千凝缓缓劈落。
剑势厚重沉稳，道韵纯正至极，不愧是执掌正道剑门百万载的顶尖大能，每一寸剑意都凝练到极致，无半分冗余瑕疵。
四周所有剑仙皆心神紧绷，死死盯着场中对决，连呼吸都下意识放轻，全身心沉浸在这无上剑道对决之中，细细体悟其中精妙。

面对这碾压同阶、威震仙界的绝世一剑，洛千凝身姿悠然伫立原地，白衣随风轻拂，不见半分慌乱闪避。
她未曾催动惊天动地的威势，也无凌厉杀伐的姿态，只是轻轻抬眸，素手微抬。
一缕灰白交织的混沌微光，自她指尖悄然流淌而出。
没有滔天剑势，没有震世威压，看似平淡无奇，孱弱微弱。
可就在这缕混沌剑意浮现的刹那，天地间所有的凌厉剑道、厚重剑势、万古剑韵，尽数瞬间凝滞！
轰！
无形的混沌剑域骤然铺开，笼罩整座论剑台！
霍凌霄劈出的无上斩天巨剑，裹挟百万载剑道底蕴的至强一击，在混沌剑域之中，如同冰雪遇骄阳、顽石碰沧海，所有的威势、所有的锋芒、所有的道韵，都在以肉眼可见的速度消融、拆解、归墟！
正统剑道的锐利，被混沌包容；万古剑势的厚重，被混沌瓦解！
所有剑道规则、定式、本源，尽数被混沌剑道吞噬抚平！
咔嚓——
清脆的碎裂声响彻长空。
content_en:
Chapter 2231 Discussing Swords (Part 2)
Huo Lingxiao's idea to compete with Luo Qianning was just a whim, but he soon realized his abruptness.
The other party was a close friend of Yun Liyue, the ancestor of the Jiange Pavilion. Even though Huo Lingxiao was the contemporary master of the Jiange Pavilion, he was not qualified to ask for advice from the other party.
However, what he didn't expect was that Luo Qianning was approachable and readily agreed to Huo Lingxiao's request.
Huo Yunxiao was ecstatic when he saw this, and the other sword immortals in the sword pavilion were all looking forward to it!
This is a duel between immortal kings, and both of them are sword immortals!
The most important thing is that they can finally truly understand how powerful Luo Qianning's Chaos Sword Intent is!
"Thank you Fairy for making it possible, then I'll be welcome!"
The light in Huo Lingxiao's eyes soared, and the aura of swordsmanship all over his body burst out in an instant!
Buzz——
A sword cry that resounded throughout the mountains suddenly exploded!
The natal immortal sword suspended behind him suddenly unsheathed, and a green light spread across the sea of ​​clouds. The orthodox swordsmanship of the Sword Pavilion that had been accumulated for tens of thousands of years was fully activated. The four ultimate sword intentions of sharp, heavy, destructive, and prison-suppressing merged into one, turning into a torrential sea of ​​swords that swept across the entire sword discussion platform.
The vast coercion of the Immortal King in the middle stage is overwhelming, the sky trembles, the clouds shatter, and all the eternal sword marks in the ground light up with bright spiritual light. The swordsmanship of the entire sword pavilion is inspired by him, blessing his body!
At the same time, these sword intentions surrounded him, forming a powerful sword formation, which was completely consistent with the swordsmanship created by Yun Liyue!
This is Huo Lingxiao's peak swordsmanship!
No reservations, purely confirming the original intention, just to learn from each other and gain enlightenment, without seeking victory or defeat.
"Heaven-cutting sword!"
Huo Lingxiao shouted low, and the sword light rose into the sky. Thousands of sword threads gathered into a formation and turned into a blue giant sword that spanned the sky and the earth. It carried the majestic momentum of suppressing the eternal and cutting off all illusions, and slowly slashed towards Luo Qianning.
The power of the sword is thick and steady, and the charm of the Tao is extremely pure. He is worthy of being the top power who has been in charge of the righteous sword sect for millions of years. Every inch of the sword's intention is condensed to the extreme, without any redundant flaws.
All the sword immortals around were tense, staring at the duel on the field. They even subconsciously relaxed their breathing, immersing themselves in this supreme sword duel, and carefully comprehending the subtleties of it.
Facing this peerless sword that crushed his peers and shocked the fairy world, Luo Qianning stood leisurely on the spot, her white clothes blowing in the wind, without any trace of panic to dodge.
She did not exert any earth-shattering power, nor did she have a fierce and killing attitude. She just raised her eyes slightly and raised her bare hands slightly.
A ray of gray and white chaotic light flowed quietly from her fingertips.
There is no monstrous sword power, no world-shaking pressure, it seems ordinary and weak.
But at the moment when this chaotic sword intention emerged, all the sharp swordsmanship, thick sword power, and eternal sword charm in the world were frozen in an instant!
boom!
The invisible chaos sword domain suddenly spread out and enveloped the entire sword discussion platform!
The supreme sky-cutting giant sword struck by Huo Lingxiao was a powerful blow that contained millions of years of swordsmanship. In the Chaos Sword Domain, it was like ice and snow meeting the scorching sun, or a rock meeting the sea. All the power, all the edge, and all the charm of the Tao were melting, dismantling, and returning to ruins at a speed visible to the naked eye!
The sharpness of the orthodox swordsmanship is contained by chaos; the weight of the eternal sword force is disintegrated by chaos!
All the rules, formulas, and origins of swordsmanship were swallowed up and smoothed by Chaos swordsmanship!
Click——
The crisp cracking sound echoed through the sky.
